system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Requests expert consultation when automated advisory is insufficient. For your information, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_9136, my issue_description is dummy_issue_description_6031, my location is dummy_location_3894.

function.name: atma_request_expert_consultation
function.description: Requests expert consultation when automated advisory is insufficient. Transitions consultation_state to 'requested'. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide immediate response. Fails if duplicate request exists. Expert availability may vary.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

issue_description.description: Description of the issue needing expert help.
